expected.finding: **[P1]** Password arguments can leak into public policy proposals. In [improvement_policy.py:100](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/improvement_policy.py:100), the scrubber handles `password=[REDACTED] but leaves `--password [REDACTED] intact. Failed-command diagnostics containing this form survive into reports and `mined_from`. A reproduction using the checked-in policy produced a revision containing the synthetic password. Scrub credential arguments before reporting or mining them.

**[P2]** CLI stdout error paths bypass redaction. In [mine-trace-failures.py:148](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/mine-trace-failures.py:148), both an `ok: false` payload and non-JSON stdout enter exceptions without scrubbing; `main()` prints those exceptions. Synthetic responses confirmed that supplied credentials remain visible. Apply the existing error scrubber to both paths before truncation and interpolation.
